title: email: POST /api/v1/email/send answers 500 EMAIL_SEND_FAILED for a malformed recipient address instead of 400 VALIDATION_FAILED
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZZ5q3itDsK1WDVLyQ

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: HTTP，`POST /api/v1/email/send`，两次独立启动各实测一次）
业务理由: 调用发信接口的集成方和自动化作者，把收件人地址写错时拿到的是 500，读起来像平台故障而不是自己的输入错误，会去重试或报障，而不是改地址；清单项 integration-system.email-template-render 的 acceptance[7]（调用方可修正的输入永不 500）因此失败，发版清单一直红。
动手的读者: 拥有 `packages/plugins/plugin-email` 的车道：让 `normalizeMessage` 里收件人校验的抛错带 `VALIDATION_FAILED:` 前缀（或 formatAddress 对调用方输入抛 VALIDATION_FAILED），并在 `packages/rest/src/email-send-door-bounds.test.ts` 旁加一条坏地址的钉子。
查重: `"Invalid email address" 500` 0 命中、`email send invalid recipient 500 EMAIL_SEND_FAILED` 0、PR `"Invalid email address" VALIDATION_FAILED` 0、`email/send VALIDATION_FAILED recipient address` 8（均为运行记录、锚卡与座位贴，含已关），无近邻。
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-l2 — 10 cards from QA run #29151 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

QA-source: #29151 · integration-system.email-template-render · acceptance[7]

## What happens
As an admin, `POST /api/v1/email/send` with `{"to":"not-an-address","subject":"s","text":"x"}` answers **500** `{"code":"EMAIL_SEND_FAILED","error":"Invalid email address: not-an-address"}`. The same holds for `to:""` (`Invalid email address: (empty)`), a recipient list with one bad member, `to:"a@b"` and `cc:"bad-cc"`. A `sys_email` row is written with status `failed`, error `rejected before delivery: Invalid email address: …`, attempt_count 0, so the service itself classes it as a pre-delivery rejection.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on two separate stock showcase boots. A well-formed `to` answers 200, and `subject:""` answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, so the route's 400 path works.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase (`os dev --seed-admin`), sign in as admin@objectos.ai.
2. `POST /api/v1/email/send` body `{"to":"not-an-address","subject":"QA bad-to","text":"x"}`.
3. **Expected:** 400 `{code:'VALIDATION_FAILED', error:'… invalid recipient address …'}`.
4. **Actual:** 500 `{"code":"EMAIL_SEND_FAILED","error":"Invalid email address: not-an-address"}`.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
`normalizeMessage` canonicalizes recipients through `listToArray` → `formatAddress` (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:284-288`), which throws `Error('Invalid email address: …')` without the `VALIDATION_FAILED:` prefix that every other `normalizeMessage` refusal carries (:313-326). The route maps only messages starting with `VALIDATION_FAILED` to 400 (`packages/rest/src/email-routes.ts:335`) and rethrows the rest to the outer catch, which answers 500 EMAIL_SEND_FAILED (:346).

Keep the boot-time sender check intact: `sender-address-validation.test.ts` expects `Invalid email address: noreply@localhost` at boot, so the fix belongs on the caller-input path.
